title: My mall world is dangerous
content: Mine always involves very high escalators and stairs that are thin with no railings. I frequently need to go outside and walk in a confusing, cold parking lot to get to another door in another part of the mall. The signs are all out of date and I need to figure out where stores actually are. Funnily enough, I have another recurring dream where there is a large store in the basement of my house and I love it there. The dangerous mall and my very happy store are in the same world. I have gone from my happy store to the scary mall many times, but never vice versa.
